༄༅/ /dpal ye shes mgon po'i gtor bsngos bsdus pa sger gsol rnams kyi gsol kha nyung ngur dril ba phrin las 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ye shes mgon po'i gtor bsngos bsdus pa sger gsol rnams kyi gsol kha nyung ngur dril ba phrin las 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma lha la phyag 'tshal nas// gtor ma bsngo ba'i rim pa bstan// bsnyen pa'i yig cha ji bzhin gyi// mgon po 'khor bcas spyan 'dren sogs// sger bskang bcas pa bgyis pa'am// gal te lang skabs dbul ba na// bsdus pa bya 'dod 'dis kyang khyab// lhag pa'i lhar sbyar sngon 'gro ba// gtor ma sbyangs rtogs sbar bas bdud rtsir gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor mgon po'i rgyud lung gis// bla ma kun bzhugs snying nas gsol ba 'debs// bstan srung mthu dang dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// bla ma rnams la gsol ba btab pa yis// 'od du zhu nas spyi bor thim par gyur// rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du// gsal ba'i mod la bgegs tshogs ring bar bskrad// bdag lus rigs brgya'i snang bsnyen 'di// kun 'dus dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom// rdo rje yan lag ma dang sbyor// zung 'jug he ru ka chas rdzogs// gar dgu'i lang tsho 'bar bar gsal// thugs srog sngags 'khor don rnams byas// hūm̐/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi ni// 'jigs su rung dang bskal pa yi// me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// pad+ma nyi zla bam chen steng*// 'jigs byed rdo rje srin po che// drag shul mi bzad khro bo'i byin// zhal gcig phyag bzhi bai ta dang*// thod khrag ral gri kha ṭ+wam̐ mtshan// rgyal po chen po rol pas bzhugs// de yi rnam par thar pa yi// rang gzugs yum chen gsum dang yang*// tshad med bzhi yi lha mo bzhi// sras bzhi mkha' 'gro bdun sogs dang*// bya gdong sde gsum bka' sdod tshogs// ma hā kā li chen mo brgyad// rdo rje pho nya drug cu bzhi// k+ṣe ṭa pa la sum cu gnyis// srid rgyal rdo rje mi 'gyur ma// lhan cig skyes ma dur khrod bdag /yab sras sprul 'khor rang rang sde// lha bdud gshin rje gza' klu btsan// gnod sbyin li byin ha'i 'khor bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba bcu bzhi dang*// nag po sha za 'bum dang yang*// snang srid lha ma srin thams cad// gang gi 'khor du bsdus nas 'khod// de rnams gnas bzhir oṃ ā:hūm̐// hoḥyi byin rlabs 'od zer 'phros// hūm̐/

'og min chos dbyings pho brang che// 'gyur med bde chen rtag pa'i gnas// sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad dang*// 'dzam gling gnas mchog ma lus nas// dpal ldan mgon po chen po ni// 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren na// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// ma thogs myur du gshegs su gsol// zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bstim/ mchod pa 'di ltar 'bul bar bya/ hūm̐/ dgra bo bsgral ba'i snying khrag rgyun// rgya mtshor bskyil ba'i rba rlabs kyi// 'jigs shugs gnam la rgol lta ba'i// ar+ghaṃ dmar po rgyas par sbreng*// nag po dug gi zhun ma yi// dpal gyi rlangs pa 'ja' rlung du// 'tshub mas gsod cing smyor 'jug pa'i// zhabs bsil gdug can mtsho ru bkod// mgo dang yan lag dbang po'i don// snod song ru ma'i zhags pa yis// phon sor bcings pa'i me tog ni// spyan ras 'bar ba'i rten du bkram// gu gul sogs dang tshil chen gyis// zhun thig ngar gyi tshwa tshwa stong*// 'khrug cing phyogs bcur 'phro byed pa'i// gsur chen sprin gyi mkha' klong gtibs// mkhris zhag khu bas sbag pa yis// ro ras dkris pa'i tsher shing gi /mi yi phung po chen po dag /phyogs kyi mun pa'i gshed du phab// sbrul snying gla rtsi gi waṃ dang*// dri zhim ngad ldan chu bo che// bsil dang sim pa bskyed pa'i phyir// byug pa'i rdzas su rdzing bur gtams// bdud dang dgra sogs g.yul ngor cher// bsad pa'i sha khrag bla srog dbugs// tshe dpal bsod nams gzi byin sogs// drag po'i zhal zas phung por spungs// rkang gling thod rnga rnga sgra dang*// nag po'i phyogs kyi ngu 'bod sgra// chos kyi dung chen du sbyar ba// snyan gyi dpyid du ci yang 'jo// gzhan yang lha klu de bzhin mi'i// dpal 'byor mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// mchod pa'i sprin du 'bul lags kyis// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs//

sger gsol rnams kyi spyan 'dren bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan sgrub brgyud rin po che'i// ring lugs 'dzin pa thams cad la/ kha 'dzin phrin las gnyer gtad pa'i// srung ma gnyan po spyan 'dren gshegs// ri rab chen po'i byang shar nas// dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas// ti si po ta ha ha rgod// lha chen zhal bzhi 'khor dang bcas// dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas nas// dpal mgon ma ning 'khor dang bcas// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas// rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor dang bcas// nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// lha chen gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas// pho brang mkha' spyod tsa ri nas// dpal ldan zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas// chu bar sprul pa'i zhing khams nas// lha sman mched lnga 'khor dang bcas// bod yul gangs brag sgrub gnas nas// brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas// dbu ri byang phyogs gnas rnams nas// sprag gi btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas// dag pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas// rdo rje g.yu sgron 'khor dang bcas// de'u brag dmar gzhal yas nas// cig char dmar po 'khor dang bcas// zhing skyong ma mo'i gnas mchog nas// dge bsnyen smyo kha 'khor dang bcas// thim yul bde chen gnas rnams nas// jag pa me len 'khor dang bcas// chos 'khor gnyan po'i gtsug lag nas// rgyal chen sku lnga 'khor dang bcas// btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas// gnod sbyin dmar po 'khor dang bcas// 'u yul shang gi gnas mchog nas// skyes bu rdor legs 'khor dang bcas// dur khrod ma mo'i gnas mchog nas// pho nya 'dre mo 'khor dang bcas// ro ldan gnas mchog gzhal yas nas// mthu stobs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas// gdod dag byin rlabs gnas mchog nas// dam can rgya mtsho khyed thams cad// dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// ma thogs myur du gshegs su gsol// dam bzhag ni/ kyai/ sngon byon de bzhin gshegs pa dang*// bdud 'dul rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*// rgyal sras rig 'dzin brgyud bcas kyis// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i// rdo rje'i tha tshig ma g.yel bar// da lta rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs// stobs rtsal bskyed pa'i skabs yin pas// ji ltar bka' bsgo legs bsgrub mdzod//

mchod pa ni/ hriḥ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas tshogs// sna tshogs rol dbyangs snyan pa'i sgras// dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas mchod// bdag sogs nad gdon 'gal rkyen dang*// sdig sgrib sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// ri gling khang bzang dpag bsam 'bras// lha mi skye 'gro sna tshogs gzugs// bza' btung longs spyod nor mdzod kyis// bstan srung lha tshogs 'khor bcas mchod// bdag sogs tshe bsod dpal 'byor nor// chos rgyud 'khor 'bangs rgyas par mdzod// 'chi med bdud rtsi a mṛ ta// rang rang srog 'khor bla rdo'i mkhar// bde chen rig ma mchod tshogs kyi// bsrung ma gnyen po 'khor bcas mchod/ khams gsum zas nor 'bru gos tshogs// thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzod// sra btsan go dang rno ngar mtshon// dpa' brjid ru mtshon g.yab pa'i dar// nyams pa bsgral ba'i dbang po yi// chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas mchod// bstan 'gror 'tshe byed sdig can dgra /dmigs med dbyings su bsgral bar mdzod// gzhan yang sman rag gtor ma dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod bskang rten// yongs rdzogs mi zad rgya mtsho'i 'jings// sngags rgya'i ting 'dzin stobs kyis 'bul// 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs// bstan 'gro bdag gzhan don mdzod cig/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ lan gsum/ gtor ma gzugs zhud drag po'i sgra// bam rul myag dri tsha skyur ro// reg rtsub 'dod pa lnga ldan pa// bdud rtsi chen por dgyes te rol// oṃ ma hā kā la ya shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i dam rat+na tra yā ya a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya de pra ti dzñā sma ra si ta dā i dam duṇ+ṭaṃ satwa na/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ki na hūm̐ phaṭ hūm̐/ thugs dkyil la phul/

oṃ ka ka ka dh+ya na/ ba ba ban+dha na/ kha kha kha da na/ sarba duṣ+ṭa naṃ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ gnod byed dgra bgegs shin+taṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ dzaḥswā hā/ gsung dkyil la phul/ oṃ a kā ro= sku'i dkyil la phul/ oṃ shri man de wī dhū maṃ ga ri sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba ling grih+ṇa gṛh+na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ma hā kā la ka la bi kā la ḍom+bhi ni sa pa ri sogs/ ma hā kā la ga na gu h+ya sa pā ri/ sogs/ bai shra ma ṇā= dzam+bha la dza len+t+ra= biṣ+ṇu rā hu la= k+ṣe ṭa pā la= maṃ laṃ aṃ tsaṃ taṃ sañtsa ḍa ki nī= ma ma kha kha la la li li tā tā ti ti= rdo rje 'bar ba a dzi li= badz+ra ma ma la la li li/ sogs/ hriṣ+ṭi wi ṭi= ti pa rā tsa= sarba suṃ tri ri tri ni kha re bh+rum̐= dharma pā la rā dza= ma hā yak+ṣa= badz+ra sā dhu sa ma dzaḥ rā li pra ma ya dza= du tri pa sha me ki na sa pa ri= kha hi/ oṃ ā ka ro lan gsum gyis phul/ dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul lo/ tshim zhing dgyes par bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung*/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong khyad par bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la/ nyin gyi bya ra/ mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen tshe dbang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan 'phel zhing*/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don ma lus par myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ bdag sogs sgrub pa po rnams kyi// dgra bgegs nag po'i phyogs 'joms shing*// zhi sogs phrin las thams cad kyi// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// zhes 'dod don gsol mgon po'i bstod pa nyung ngu ni/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs tshe/ khams gsum bsreg pa'i me chen nang*// rten 'brel rnam dag phyag rgya che// 'khor los bsgyur ba khyod la bstod// rdo rje'i gar brgya mdzad pa'i tshe// sku mdog mthing nag khro bo'i byin// gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/

za byed chen po khyed la bstod// rnal 'byor dgra lha mdzad pa'i tshe// zhi sogs las kyi dbang 'dzin pa'i// dngos grub thogs med ci yang stsol// dbang phyug chen po khyed la bstod// gdug pa ma rungs 'dul ba'i tshe// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul chen po yis// stong gsum gdug pa'i dmag gis 'gengs// dpa' bo chen po khyod la bstod// sangs rgyas spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i// thugs dam gnyen po brtser dgongs la// rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob kyi// bzhed dgu lhun gyis grub par mdzod// sger gsol bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rang bzhin gnas zhing thams cad nas// dpal ldan ye shes lha mo mchog /mkha' 'gro nag mo dud sol ma// 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do// pad nyi ro gdan g.yas bskum tshul// g.yon brkyang nag po dbu skra khams// lha mchog zhal bzhi zhing skyong dang*// bram gzugs yum bzhi 'khor bcas bstod// 'og min lhun grub dur khrod 'jigs// dpal mgon mthing nag zhal gcig pa// sku gsum spyan gsum byin mthu gzigs// ma ning mched gsum sku la bstod// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen mang*// 'gro la thugs bskyed rgyal chen tshul// sa gsum dbul sel yid bzhin nor// yum blon 'khor tshogs bcas la bstod// bcom ldan mthu stobs rdo rje'i 'dzin// rgyal bstan bsrung phyir srin mgon tshul// gza' bdud chen po rā hu la// yab yum 'khor dang bcas la bstod// he ru ka dpal che ba'i mchog /ma rungs 'joms phyir bdud mgon tshul// sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong*// yum sprul sde 'khor bcas la bstod// rigs kyi ye shes ḍa k+ki ni// gang 'dul bod khams skyong ma'i tshul// lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma// mched lnga 'khor dang bcas la bstod// chos dbyings skye ba med pa las// thugs rje'i gzugs kyi sku sprul pa// brtan ma chen mo bcu gnyis ni// bka' sdod bran g.yog bcas la bstod// mi bskyod rdo rje bcom ldan 'das// bstan pa bsrung phyir sems dpa'i tshul// ston mdzad dge bsnyen sprag gi btsan// yum sras blon 'bangs bcas la bstod// rgyal yum ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// bar chad sel phyir sman btsun tshul// rdo rje g.yu sgron dam tshig can// rang rang rigs sde bcas la bstod// bcom ldan pad+ma he ru kaḥ

phrin las mdzad phyir btsan rgod tshul// cig char dmar po mthu stobs can// 'khor tshogs sde dpung bcas la bstod// 'phags mchog snying rje'i bdag nyid can// las rnams bsgrub phyir klu yi mgon// smyon kha'i rje btsun mthu bo che// yum 'khor sde tshogs bcas la bstod// bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs mgon po mchog /rnal 'byor skyong phyir gnas srung tshul// dge bsnyen rdo rje'i dgra 'dul che// mched gsum yum 'khor bcas la bstod// 'khor lo drwa ba sdom pa che// bstan 'gro skyong phyir srid pa'i bdag /chos kyi rgyal po sku lnga dang*// yum sprul 'khor dang bcas la bstod// dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog dpal// las rnams sgrub mdzad gnod sbyin tshul// 'jig rten lha srin yongs kyi rje// ya ba rkya bdun bcas la bstod// rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// rnal 'byor skyong phyir gter bdag tshul// dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs// mched 'khor bcas la bdag bstod do// dbyings kyi yum chen wa ra hi// dur khrod ma mo rnams sprul pa'i// bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba yi// dkor srung chen mo'i 'khor bcas bstod// dregs pa phrin las tshogs kyi sde// bstan srung dpa' zhing khros pa'i gzugs// mthing nag ber sprul thod rlon brgyan// bstan dgra 'joms mdzad bcas la bstod/ khyed rnams srung ma dam tshig can// bdag ni brgyud 'dzin sgrub pa po// las dam gnyen po gcig pas na// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sgrubs/ 'jig rten bde zhing chos la spyod// rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag rgyas// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan phrin las spel// dge 'dun bshad sgrub dar bar mdzod// dam chos bsgrub pa'i rkyen sol la// nyams rtogs gzhan phan rgyas par mdzod// mdor na bdag cag bsam pa'i don// ma lus lhun grub nyid du mdzod// mdun bskyed dam tshig rten la thim// ye shes pa rnams rang la bsdus// bdag lha rim bsdu mi dmigs ngang*// stong nyid slar yang las lhar gyur// dge ba 'di yis myur du

sogs dge bsngo smon lam shis brjod bya'o// rigs 'dus mgon po'i dkyil 'khor tshogs// pu sta ka yi tshad lang pa'i// don kun nyung ngu 'dir 'dus pa'i// snying po khyer bde ngo mtshar rmad// mno sems gzhig cing yang yang bcos// 'di yis dka' tshig dgos pa ci// gang dran bkod med myur bris pa// 'gro gdong dus thug ga la 'ong*// ces pa'ang mkhyen mchog gi bdag nyid rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde rin chen bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis gsung ngor/ snyom las pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis lam thog tu spel ba phrin las 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /sarba maṅga lam/// /
